faq.title: Questions? Answers.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.q1: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a1: No. Zero knowledge needed. Just describe what you want in normal words — like you would explain it to a friend.
faq.a2: Websites, apps for phones and computers, online shops, newsletters — anything you can describe. If you can imagine it, BLUN can build it.
faq.a3: Yes. The free plan is free forever. You only pay if you need more power or access to cloud AI models like Claude, GPT, or Gemini.
